request.summary: Create a responsive operations KPI board with summary metrics, target progress, and a trend chart.
request.audience: Operations teams monitoring fulfillment performance on shared displays.
request.primaryGoal: Make current performance and exceptions immediately legible while retaining recent trend context.

assumptions: Metrics and history remain separate collections because flattening them would lose their relationship.
The dashboard renders at most three primary metrics and twenty-four trend points.

surfaces.purpose: Wide dashboard band with compressed secondary detail.

states.expectation: An explicit empty state occupies the dashboard without layout collapse.
Long metric labels and deltas remain readable in a wide-low surface.
Updated metrics replace current values without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: The trend remains bounded while the KPI hierarchy adapts around it.
Datasource updates propagate to metric labels and values.

visualReview.intent: A quiet operational dashboard with one dominant metric story, restrained surfaces, and a readable trend.
focus: Verify the chart never crowds or overlaps metric cards at narrow and tall sizes.
Verify numeric values remain dominant while long supporting text truncates or wraps intentionally.
